create_optimizer_instance: create a FairseqOptimizer instance with a config object to manage model training optimization
set_learning_rate: set the learning rate for all parameter groups in the FairseqOptimizer using set_lr
perform_optimization_step: perform a single optimization step with optional scale and groups using the step method
clip_gradient_norm: clip the gradient norm to a maximum value using clip_grad_norm on the optimizer
load_optimizer_state: load an optimizer state dict with optional overrides to resume training from a checkpoint
